The story behind the plate

A little terrace.
A big dream.

Kai Manam’s story began with Vishnu Priya, a former radio jockey who turned her love for cooking into a food business. What started as a modest terrace kitchen during the pandemic grew into a full restaurant and, later, a second dine-in outlet on Chennai’s East Coast Road.

The idea stayed simple: food that feels personal, familiar and comforting — the kind of meal you remember after the last bite.
